profile.headline: Staff Software Engineering at Google
profile.summary:
I get excited by data-driven solutions to real-world problems.  My background is in mathematics and computer science, and I have experiences ranging from large-scale genomic data mining to cloud based software development for a commercial product (the Amazon Echo).

I have built statistical software for biologists, analyzed genetic data of patients with cancer, and have helped build and launch Amazon's voice-activated digital assistant.

I am seeking a career that allows me to solve problems through statistical and machine learning techniques applied to rich, real-world data.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I am a Software Development Engineer at Amazon's Lab126, working on Amazon Echo, the voice-controlled personal assistant for your home.  I work on the "brain" of Amazon Echo, meaning I build scalable cloud-side applications that make the Echo delightful to use.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Worked on a diverse team of software engineers, doctors, and research scientists to develop gene panels for identification of cancer, heart diseases, and possible drug reactions.

Developed an algorithm to make it easier for our team to find mentions of genetic mutations and related diseases and other phenotypes in the clinical literature.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed tools to help biologists analyze their microarray and next-generation sequencing data.  Developed workflows for the differential RNA expression analysis, ChIP-Seq peak finding, and microRNA-mRNA interaction discovery.  I implemented visualization tools such as Hilbert Space-Filling Curves and Self-Organizing Maps.
